verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an Alerts product and email alerts and notifications, and Crons can raise alerts on scheduled-job events. Ownership Rules and Webhooks pages exist, but the pack gives only their titles, with no detail on rule conditions or automatic actions. Seer can hand root cause analysis to coding agents for automated fixes, but nothing shows this is driven by user-defined rules. Missing for 10: documented rule conditions and triggers, configurable action types beyond notifications, evidence that Seer or agent handoff can be triggered by rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Once implemented, it'll allow you to get alerts and metrics
